cues.text: Before your undead opponent gets a chance to attack,
you lunge at its chest with a deft movement!
But just before your blade finds its target,
you surprisingly swing it upwards, against the beast's throat,
where it leaves a gaping, smoking wound,
without the werewolf having the slightest chance of parrying your truly murderous blow!
The undead creature, badly wounded by your consecrated weapon,
sinks to the ground with a look of disbelief in its eyes and breathes out its "life".
"Knocked out by premature death in the first round!"
- smugly you put your sword back into its sheath and blow on your fingernails,
when it occurs to you that this could also be a trick:
carefully, one hand firmly gripping the hilt of your sword,
you kneel down next to the wolf's body to see whether your opponent is really dead...
Your worry was unfounded: steaming,
greenish blood is running from a long, gaping wound in its throat.
But something else you have to see is a
little red blood sticking to one of the wolf's claws -
and when you examine yourself, plagued by dark forebodings,
you discover a small but rather deep wound on your left leg,
which the wolf must have torn while falling, and from which - GREEN blood is now oozing!
CRAP!
Now that you have noticed it, the wound starts to burn like hell: the infection has begun,
and it will only be a matter of time before you,
too, start turning into a beast at full moon!
As you sit down, resigned,
on one of the fallen gravestones to brood over your uncertain fate,
the wolf's body turns into the decaying corpse of
what must once have been a beautiful young woman,
who seems to look up at you gratefully!
When you try to touch her - she crumbles to dust...
